name: Eastern Shore Natural Gas 2003-2005 Expansion Phase 3
monitor_reason: length: EIA's 24 mi (single origin, Aug 2026 release, Historical Projects sheet row 380, cost 14 million, +9.9 MMcf/d, 16 in) conflicts with the FERC notice, which says Phase III of the 2003 certificate was about 3.0 miles of 16-inch pipe (Phase II 2.7 mi, Phase I a meter station upgrade). Well under the 25 km (15.5 mi) threshold on the only corroborated figure. Completed 2005, so no open concrete step to track.
researcher_notes: Not an existing row: P0182 is the system row and P2003 and P6003 are later expansions, none covers 2003-2005. The EIA row is ESNG 2003-5 Expansion Phase 3, docket CP03-80, completed 2005-11-30. A FERC Federal Register notice of intent from February 4, 2005 (E5-450, govinfo.gov, checked with url_verifier) describes the amended project: Phase III as certificated is about 3.0 miles of 16-inch loop to be built in 2005, and the amendment adds segments of 1.4, 3.2, 6.0 and 10.3 miles at 6 to 16 inch. EIA's 24 mi may be the amended project total, not one 16-inch loop. The 24 mi cannot be tied to Phase III alone. If a researcher wants a row, the unit would need a FERC order or in-service filing stating as-built miles. Left as monitor with no values staged.
